decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - 2.	The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period expiring 3 years from the date of implementation when the use shall cease.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith and numbered DWG001, 1231-01 to 1231-05 and 1231-7.Received: 15 September 2010Amended Design & Access Statement &  788/07       Received: 12 November 2010 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - 4.	The site shall be used as a Further Education (D1 use) and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 5 - 5.	6 independent vehicle parking spaces shall be available for use before first occupation of any part of the development and such spaces shall not be used for any other purposes
description: Change of use from B1 (Office Use) to D1 (Educational Use)
